# PlanOnce v0.7.0

PlanOnce is an open-source framework for building high-quality software with any AI coding agent.

Core principle: route to the smallest safe workflow, plan once, execute in bounded steps, verify revision-bound fresh evidence, recover without unnecessary replanning, and keep humans in control at meaningful gates.

## Main documentation

- /docs/ - Overview and v0.7 contract
- /docs/getting-started/ - Installation, initialization, planonce-task, and first controlled change
- /docs/workflows/ - Greenfield and Brownfield workflow guide
- /docs/reliability/ - Artifact schemas, plan fingerprints, evidence freshness, recovery, workspace locks, and evals
- /docs/architecture/ - PlanOnce authority with Agent OS v3.0.0 and GSD Core v1.12.0 upstream engines
- /docs/providers/ - Provider support and installation
- /docs/security-review/ - Security, stale evidence, production review, backlog, and readiness
- /docs/design-system/ - Moon-orbit website design system and brand assets

## Workflow control loop

CLASSIFY -> CONTEXT -> SHAPE -> APPROVE -> EXECUTE -> VERIFY -> REVIEW -> SHIP

planonce-task is route-only and exits before implementation planning.

Normal and Large workflows fingerprint the human-approved PLAN.md. Verification is bound to the relevant Git revision, working-tree digest, and accepted plan digest. Failed checks route to FIX_REVERIFY, BLOCKED_AMEND, or DIAGNOSE based on evidence.

## Installation

Primary cross-provider install:

npx skills add <owner>/planonce-agent-skills --all

Project-local copy:

npx skills add <owner>/planonce-agent-skills --all --copy -y

Validated provider ids include:

- claude-code
- codex
- opencode
- cursor
- gemini-cli
- github-copilot
- cline
- kilo
- kiro-cli
- roo
- windsurf
- qwen-code
- goose
- openhands

Example targeted install:

npx skills add <owner>/planonce-agent-skills --skill '*' -a opencode -y

Replace <owner> after the GitHub repository owner is finalized.
